title: Jimmy Butler scores 25 points in Warriors debut, helps lead 24-point comeback win over Bulls
text:
If Jimmy Butler’s debut with the Golden State Warriors is a sign of things to come, this team could be quite fun again.
The former Miami Heat star recorded 25 points in 7 of 12 shots, four assists and two rebounds in her first game since she joined the Warriors in the exchange deadline. That performance was an important part of an return of 24 points for Golden State, who defeated the Chicago Bulls 132-111 on Saturday.
While Butler joked during his introduction that his plan was to “pass the ball to Steph and get out of the way,” he offered much more than that next to Stephen Curry.
In particular, Butler’s shirt showed the name “Butler III” along with his No. 10. After the game He revealed that the change was permanent and in honor of his father, who died a year ago until the day.
Curry was the other leader of the Warriors victory, registering 34 points in 10 of 19 shots (8 of 16 from a range of 3 points), six assists and five rebounds.
Butler joined the Warriors earlier this week in a complicated trade of four teams that cost the Andrew Wiggins team, Dennis Schröder, Kyle Anderson, Lindy Waters III and a Protected First Round selection. The six-time All-Star left the heat in somewhat hostile terms, since he received three suspensions separated by a variety of crimes that were reduced to him that they no longer wanted to play for the team.
The Warriors represented a new beginning for Butler, especially after they gave it an extension of two years and $ 121 million that will align their mandate with the team along with the current Curry agreement. Golden State now has the oldest core of the League with Butler, 35, 36 -year -old Curry and Draymond Green, 34, but that is not a problem when you try to win now.
The victory improved the Warriors record at 26-26, it is currently good for the tenth place and the last game at the West Conference. They will face a more rigid test on Monday, when they face the Milwaukee Bucks along the way.
